object: FIELD Index 0.8.23 read-only packet egress reducer and source-witness convergence cut
source_instruction: Take point; align to shared context and ship through/into/over/across FIELD INDEX. Converge prior packet-return, Tests A–H, COAXIALITY and FIELD aggregation work rather than creating another branch of architecture.
recovered: packet egress grammar: OBJECT / AUTHORITY / STATE_IN / DELTA / EVIDENCE / STATE_OUT / RESIDUE / WAITING / NEXT / STOP
RETURN reducer: CLOSE | RESIDUE | WAITING | CONTRADICTION
FIELD projection: NOW / DELTA / RESIDUE / GATE / NEXT≤3 / ARCHIVE
Tests A–H: STATE / RELATION / LEGIBILITY / REVERSAL / IDENTITY / PROVENANCE / RETURN / COMPRESSION
COAXIALITY host-owned semantics law from merged PR #543
delta: /lib/field-egress-reducer.js adds a pure read reducer; packets cannot self-promote to NOW
/tools/field-egress-reducer-selftest.cjs proves NOW authority, RETURN classes, NEXT≤3, semantic-Git filtering and source freshness/conflict behavior
/control/FIELD_INDEX_CONTRACT.json v0.5 binds packet egress and A–H deletion-or-repair audit without a new route/store/queue
/ index contracts CONVERGE / NEXUS into CONVERGE / FIELD and renders SOURCE WITNESS + FIELD EGRESS inside the existing collapsed re-entry fold
NEXUS and COMMS remain exactly reachable but are labeled snapshots; their generated refresh commits stay literal Git chronology and are excluded from semantic DELTA
FIELD root advances to 0.8.23 in CURRENT + showcase manifest
invariants: CURRENT alone owns NOW and CURRENT-authorized NEXT
Git remains the literal repository chronology
QUEUE compatibility state, WAITING registry state and atlas horizon do not manufacture attention
derived source validity/freshness never becomes source authority
RETURN never authorizes a second move
no new route, dashboard, state store, bus or domain ontology

audit.H: COMPRESSION removes more surface complexity than it creates
audit.disposition: failure => named REPAIR when host needs the function; otherwise CONTRACT/DELETE. Identity/provenance/reversal/RETURN failures block promotion.

known_limits: The external void-anchor/ops-hub writer that periodically commits NEXUS/COMMS snapshots to master is outside this repository's available control path. This delta demotes those commits semantically but does not claim to stop that writer.
SOURCE HEAD uses each source's explicit revision timestamp marker where no content hash exists; it is intentionally distinct from Git HEAD.
The reducer reads existing source truth; it does not reconcile contradictions automatically.
residue: Stop external NEXUS/COMMS writeback only at its actual ops-hub generator/transport authority; do not fake that stop in FIELD.
If source-witness rows do not reduce re-entry friction in ordinary use, contract/delete them under Test H rather than expand the panel.
next: Run exact-head proof. If green, merge 0.8.23. Then re-enter FIELD through the derived cut and select at most one CURRENT-authorized consequence.
stop: No second aggregation interface; no new packet store; no semantic promotion of stale telemetry.
